commons.title: Ceremony for Warrulan - 2023-10-07 - Andy Mabbett - 13.jpg
commons.description: Mark Koolmatrie a Ngarrindjeri elder from South Australia, presents gifts following a traditional ceremony at Warstone Lane Cemetery in Birmingham, England, to take the spirit of Warrulan, who was buried there in 1855, back home to the Murray River.
commons.editorial_reason: Caption identifies a Ngarrindjeri elder performing a traditional ceremony and presenting culturally attributed gifts; the image visibly shows the crafted objects.
